ability a hero action or persistent trait defined by packaged gameplay data. abilities occupy basic, passive, random, or special loadout slots. combat / glossary
basic ability the hero's standard combat action in the basic loadout slot. combat / glossary
class a hero's broad combat role: sentinel, ravager, or tempest. hero / glossary
cooldown the recovery period after an ability is used before it can be activated again. combat / glossary
crogenitor level the progression level used to determine when hero profiles become available. hero / glossary
element a hero's genesis affinity. the archive preserves the content labels cyber, chrono, bio, plasma, and necro. hero / glossary
enemy a combat-capable non-player creature recovered from placed level nouns and class data. archive / glossary
energy damage one of corrupted's two broad damage channels. abilities identify their authored damage channel separately from their elemental theme. combat / glossary
genesis the in-game term for elemental affinity, used to group heroes and combat relationships. hero / glossary
genetic variant one of four profiles in a hero family: alpha, beta, gamma, or delta. variants can change unlock level, statistics, and the variant ability. hero / glossary
health a creature's remaining survivability. a hero or enemy is defeated when its health is exhausted. combat / glossary
hero a playable genetic combatant with an element, class, statistics, equipment, and ability loadout. hero / glossary
hero family the archive grouping that combines a hero's four genetic variants into one dossier. hero / glossary
item a piece of equipment used to improve a hero. the archive groups procedural item variations beneath a recovered base family. equipment / glossary
item level the level attached to an equipment roll, used as a compact indication of that item's progression tier. equipment / glossary
level a playable or development area recovered from packaged level, chain, marker, and spawn data. archive / glossary
locale key a stable identifier used to look up authored text in corrupted's localization tables. archive / glossary
noun corrupted's content term for a game object definition, including creatures, projectiles, pickups, and world objects. archive / glossary
package a dbpf container from the corrupted client that stores typed game resources such as ui images, levels, scripts, and asset definitions. archive / glossary
passive ability an always-on or automatically triggered ability in the passive loadout slot. combat / glossary
physical damage one of corrupted's two broad damage channels, distinct from energy damage. combat / glossary
power the resource spent to activate abilities. packaged lua registrations commonly call this value mana cost internally. combat / glossary
prefix a procedural item-name component associated with one set of generated item modifiers. equipment / glossary
quantum the player-facing affinity name associated with quantum and spacetime powers. some recovered content fields use the label chrono. hero / glossary
ravager one of the three hero classes, generally associated with aggressive close-range or mobile combat. hero / glossary
rigblock a generated equipment record that joins a visual part, compatible affinities, and procedural item data. equipment / glossary
sentinel one of the three hero classes, generally associated with durability and defensive control. hero / glossary
special ability an activated hero ability occupying one of the two special loadout positions. combat / glossary
squad a player-selected group of heroes used together during an expedition. hero / glossary
status effect a temporary gameplay condition that buffs, damages, controls, protects, or restricts a creature. combat / glossary
suffix a procedural item-name component associated with an additional generated modifier. equipment / glossary
tempest one of the three hero classes, generally associated with ranged abilities and support or control. hero / glossary
variant ability the ability that changes between a hero family's alpha, beta, gamma, and delta profiles. the archive labels this as the random slot. combat / glossary
